faq.q: What does the Marbella family boat day include?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). Snorkel gear and a paddleboard are provided free of charge. Jet ski can be added as an extra or is included on Tier B boats (Mangusta 80) for a minimum 4-hour booking.

faq.q: Which boats are available for the family combo?
faq.a: The family combo is typically offered on Tier A boats: Astondoa 40 (12.5m, up to 9 passengers) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, up to 11 passengers). Both depart from Puerto Banús. For larger groups or a jet ski included, consider Tier B Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax, from €4,719 for 4 hours).

faq.q: How much does the family boat day cost?
faq.a: Tier A boats start at €749 for 2 hours and go up to €2,299 for 8 hours. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. Tier B Mangusta 80 is from €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours, with a jet ski included free. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

faq.q: Can we bring our own food or drinks?
faq.a: Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and drinks onboard. The charter already includes water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. If you have specific dietary needs or want a catered menu, let us know in advance and we can arrange it.

faq.q: Is the jet ski suitable for children?
faq.a: Jet ski usage is generally for ages 16+ with a valid licence (or under supervision with a skipper). For younger children, the paddleboard and snorkel gear are perfect. Life jackets are provided for all ages. Please advise us of children's ages when booking so we can prepare appropriate equipment.

faq.q: Where do we depart from and what are the nearby attractions?
faq.a: All charters depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella. You can explore the Costa del Sol coastline, including Cabopino, Estepona, and Cala del Faro. The iconic La Concha mountain provides a stunning backdrop. We recommend anchoring near Cala Cortés for calm waters ideal for snorkelling and paddleboarding.

Cancellations made 48 hours or more before departure receive a full refund. Within 48 hours, a 50% refund applies. No-shows or same-day cancellations are non-refundable. Weather-related cancellations by the skipper are fully refundable or can be rescheduled.

faq.q: How do I book the Marbella family boat day?
faq.a: You can book directly via our website or contact us on WhatsApp for personalised advice. For Tier A boats, simply select your preferred date and duration (2h, 4h, 6h, or 8h). For other boats or custom requests, message us and we'll confirm availability within minutes.

data.body_html:
Looking for a Marbella family boat day jet ski snorkel paddleboard combo 2043? You've found the perfect mix of adventure and relaxation on the Costa del Sol. Departing from Puerto Banús, our family-friendly charters let you explore the Mediterranean with everything included: a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and all water toys. Whether you choose a 2-hour taster or a full 8-hour day, you'll have access to snorkel gear, a paddleboard, and optional jet ski add-ons. Prices start from €749 for 2 hours on a Tier A boat like the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39—both spacious and comfortable for families.

Why Choose a Family Boat Day in Marbella?

Marbella's coastline offers calm bays, clear waters, and over 300 sunny days a year. A private charter gives you freedom: no crowded tour boats, no fixed itineraries. You decide where to anchor—maybe Cala del Faro for snorkelling or Cala Cortés for paddleboarding. The sea temperature ranges from 18°C in spring to 26°C in summer, making water activities enjoyable from April to October. Plus, with a skipper at the helm, parents can relax while kids splash safely.

What's Included in the Combo?

  • Licensed English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Unlimited water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts)
  • Snorkel masks, fins, and paddleboard
  • Safety equipment and life jackets (all sizes)
  • Insurance and Spanish IVA (21%)

Jet ski is included free on Tier B boats (Mangusta 80) for minimum 4-hour bookings. For Tier A boats, you can add a jet ski as an extra—contact us via WhatsApp for pricing.

Sample Itinerary: 4-Hour Family Day

  1. 10:00 – Meet at Puerto Banús, board your boat, safety briefing.
  2. 10:15 – Cruise east towards Cabopino, spotting La Concha mountain.
  3. 10:45 – Anchor at Cala del Faro. Kids snorkel while parents paddleboard.
  4. 12:00 – Jet ski session (if added) or free swim.
  5. 13:00 – Light lunch onboard with drinks.
  6. 13:45 – Slow cruise back to Puerto Banús.
  7. 14:00 – Disembark.

Longer charters can include stops at Estepona or even lunch at a beach club. Your skipper will tailor the route to your preferences.

Jet Ski, Snorkel & Paddleboard: How It Works

Jet ski: On Tier B boats, one jet ski is included free for 4+ hour bookings. On Tier A, we can arrange a jet ski rental as an add-on. Minimum age is 16 with a licence, or ride as a passenger with the skipper.

Snorkel gear: Masks, snorkels, and fins are provided for all ages. The best spots near Marbella include Cala Cortés and the rocky coves around Cabopino, where water clarity often exceeds 10 metres.

Paddleboard: A stable inflatable paddleboard is onboard. It's great for kids and adults alike—try standing up in the calm waters of the Bay of Marbella.

Best Time of Year for a Family Boat Day

The Costa del Sol enjoys a microclimate. From May to October, sea temperatures are 20–26°C, and air temperatures range from 25–35°C. July and August are peak season—book early. Spring and autumn offer quieter anchorages and lower prices. Even in winter, sunny days allow for comfortable cruising (though water activities may be chilly).

How to Book Your Marbella Family Boat Day

Ready to secure your date? Browse our full fleet at Boat Rental Marbella and choose your preferred boat. For Tier A, simply select 2h, 4h, 6h, or 8h. For Tier B or custom combos, message us on WhatsApp. We'll confirm availability and send a booking link. Payment is secure, and cancellation is free up to 48 hours before departure.
